name: park-kit
task: Teach the bot the order `do gen_park <r>` (r = half-size, 1..8; the executive passes it as st.count, or null when the order gave no count — then r = 4): plant a park — a small square of trees in a staggered (checkerboard) pattern — centred on the player who gave the order. Find that player by scanning entities() for the player entry whose username matches st.by (fall back to the nearest player entry); centre the square on their floored x,z. The square is (2r+1)^2 cells. Plant the pitch-2 checkerboard: saplings sit on grid cells whose dx,dz from the anchor are both even, and only where (dx/2 + dz/2) is even — diagonal neighbours land at (2,2), orthogonal at 4, so no two saplings stand within Chebyshev distance 1 of each other and every tree has light and room. The anchor is the ordering player’s floored x,z; the square (2r+1)^2 stays centred there and cells outside it are skipped. For r=3 that is 5 cells: the anchor itself plus (±2,±2). A sapling stands on soil: the cell below must be grass_block or dirt — when the top block is not soil, dig it with dig() and place dirt from the pack with place(), never dig below the surface level and never place dirt the pack does not hold. The pack already holds oak_sapling and dirt: plant straight from it. Gate the skill: feasible only when facts.pinned === 'gen_park' and facts time is 'day'. Never touch the castle ring or apron (the facade refuses those cells with denied:place-protected — stay clear of any castle). There is no chat and no toss/drop: the executive chats done/failed itself. Return 'done' only when every lattice cell holds a sapling; return 'failed:no-saplings' when the pack runs out of saplings.
